primitives.name: Product Launch Readiness Score
primitives.verbatim_quote: # Launch Readiness Scorecard As of: 2026-06-09 This scorecard supersedes the earlier docs-only score.

primitives.breakdown_regime: S_launch < 60 indicates critical system-wide failure requiring immediate remediation.

primitives.name: NPM Test Failure Rate

primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'f_test-fail': 'Dimensionless fraction of failing NPM tests', 'F_failed': 'Integer count of failed NPM tests (3 in current instance)', 'F_total': 'Integer total count of NPM tests run'}
primitives.assumptions: All tests are independent Bernoulli trials with constant failure probability.
primitives.breakdown_regime: f_test-fail > 0.10 indicates unstable build pipeline prone to regression.

primitives.name: Website Design Quality Score
primitives.verbatim_quote: | | Website/design | RED | 45 | Static pricing/promotions/methodology look premium; homepage is an error card.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'Q_design': 'Dimensionless website design quality score', 'w_p': 'Weight on premium aesthetics (typically 0.6)', 'Q_p': 'Quality score for premium static assets (e.g., 0.8)', 'w_h': 'Weight on homepage functionality (typically 0.4)', 'Q_h': 'Quality score for homepage error handling (e.g., 0.1)'}
primitives.assumptions: Linear additive contribution from aesthetic and functional components with fixed weights.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Q_design < 0.5 triggers immediate frontend rewrite mandate.

layer2.mapping: Derives from GSE state-transition models for user-interface state persistence.
layer2.telemetry: Conversion rate drop per unit decrease in design quality score

primitives.name: Roster Truth Definition
primitives.verbatim_quote: | Define real roster source and add canary harness or mark out of launch scope.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'R': 'Set of all player roster records', 'r_i': 'Individual player record (structured dictionary)', 'N': 'Total number of players in roster'}
primitives.assumptions: Roster data must be complete, consistent, and derivable from authoritative external sources.
primitives.breakdown_regime: N == 0 indicates catastrophic data loss event.

layer2.mapping: Maps to GSI information fusion algorithms for combining multiple data streams into unified player statistics.
layer2.telemetry: Data freshness metrics vs. user engagement decay curves
